switch.name: aileron trigger
switch.test: fcs/fbw-enabled eq 0 fcs/stovl-pos-norm gt 0 gear/unit[0]/WOW eq 1 gear/unit[1]/WOW eq 1 gear/unit[2]/WOW eq 1

fcs/roll-stick-abs gt 0.02 fcs/roll-rate-abs-deg_sec gt 10
fcs/roll-command ge 1 fcs/roll-trim-error gt 0
fcs/roll-command le -1 fcs/roll-trim-error lt 0
